system.description: Advanced Move. When you attempt to counter magic as it is being cast, roll+SPELL.

success.label: Success!
success.value: The magic is successfully countered and doesn't come to pass.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value:
The magic is countered but choose one:
• You can't use magic for a short time.
• The unraveled magic causes some collateral damage or side effects.
• It's only partially countered, a weaker version manifests instead.
